title: PhoneLink
summary: Pair a phone with this computer's Kollab app using a short-lived invitation and local approval.

workflows.label: Link a phone browser
workflows.summary: Create a one-phone invitation on the computer and approve the pairing code there.

entry.prerequisite: Keep the computer online with Kollab running. The selected Connect directory must serve the PhoneLink portal.

steps.action: On the computer, open Settings → PhoneLink and select Link a Phone. Confirm that the portal is available before sharing an invitation.
On the phone you are linking, scan the QR code with its camera, or use Open on This Phone in the same browser.
Compare the pairing code and host fingerprint shown on both screens; approve only on the computer if they match.
On the phone, let the app load, then bookmark it or add it to the Home Screen. Revoke a lost phone from Settings → PhoneLink on the computer.

media.alt: Kollab PhoneLink settings with Link a Phone and the three pairing steps
media.caption: Start Link a Phone on the computer. Compare the code and fingerprint before approving.

workflows.success: The approved phone opens this computer's app in its browser; agents, provider calls and tools still run on the computer.

recovery.symptom: The computer does not offer a QR code
recovery.action: Check the portal capability shown in PhoneLink settings and configure the selected Connect directory to serve the PhoneLink portal before retrying.

recovery.symptom: The invitation expired or was already used
recovery.action: On the computer, start Link a Phone again and scan the fresh invitation.

recovery.symptom: The pairing code or fingerprint does not match
recovery.action: Do not approve. Cancel the request and create a new invitation on the computer.

recovery.symptom: Phone history does not load or an older link is stale
recovery.action: Use the history retry control. If the session cursor is stale, reopen the conversation to load the latest page and continue scrolling for older history.

workflows.note: The QR invitation expires after five minutes and links one phone. It does not enroll the phone in your agent network or transfer provider credentials. Approving a phone grants trusted app control until you revoke it.

workflows.label: Browse conversation history on the phone
workflows.summary: PhoneLink opens the latest messages and loads older pages as you scroll back.

entry.prerequisite: Use a phone browser already paired with the computer running Kollab.

steps.action: Open the paired app and select a conversation.
steps.expect: PhoneLink shows the newest messages first.

steps.action: Scroll to the top to load older history on demand.
steps.expect: Progress is shown, with a retry action if a load fails.

steps.action: Expand a tool when you need its full output.
steps.expect: Details load when you expand a tool, so long chats open fast.

workflows.success: The phone displays recent history and loads earlier messages as needed without requesting the entire conversation at once.

recovery.symptom: History shows a retryable loading error
recovery.action: Use the visible retry action while the computer remains online.

recovery.symptom: A page cursor is stale after history changed
recovery.action: Reopen or refresh the conversation; PhoneLink requests the latest page and avoids silently skipping older messages.
